message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Two new vulnerabilities credibly matching the monitored product list were published in the last 24 hours. The review window was 2026-08-09 23:40 UTC through 2026-08-10 23:40 UTC (2026-08-10 05:10 IST through 2026-08-11 05:10 IST).

**Finding 1**

- **Affected product/component:** WordPress — Sucuri Security plugin through 2.7.3
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-73033 — path traversal leading to arbitrary file deletion
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 4.0 score 7.0 (the record also reports CVSS 3.1 score 6.5, Medium)
- **Description:** An authenticated WordPress administrator can supply traversal sequences to delete files outside the WordPress installation directory, potentially causing an outage or enabling malicious reinstallation. Version 2.7.4 contains the reported fix.
- **Why it is relevant:** Sucuri Security is a WordPress plugin, directly matching the monitored WordPress product family.
- **Sources:** [CVE Project record](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2026/73xxx/CVE-2026-73033.json); [Sucuri project disclosure](https://github.com/Sucuri/sucuri-wordpress-plugin/issues/217)

**Finding 2**

- **Affected product/component:** WordPress — WP Umbrella plugin 2.24.2 through 2.26.2
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-66642 — cross-site request forgery (CSRF)
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 3.1 score 5.4
- **Description:** The plugin is vulnerable to CSRF, allowing a malicious request to trigger unauthorized actions when an authenticated user interacts with attacker-controlled content. The vendor reports the issue fixed in version 2.27.0.
- **Why it is relevant:** WP Umbrella is a WordPress plugin, directly matching the monitored WordPress product family.
- **Sources:** [CVE Project record](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2026/66xxx/CVE-2026-66642.json); [WP Umbrella vendor advisory](https://wp-umbrella.com/blog/security-disclosure-csrf-vulnerability-in-the-wp-umbrella-plugin-fixed-in-2-27-0/)

Prompt review is recommended for WordPress deployments using either plugin, with priority on Sucuri Security because the reported impact includes deletion of sensitive files. No other fresh CVE or vendor advisory in the window could be tied confidently to the monitored products; routine metadata updates and loosely related component-name matches were excluded.
